_readme: From the researcher's q12_vd.json (3 steady periods, k 0.86, RES 127), reduced to vd and u (u = 2VT*tanh(vd/2VT)) in MICROVOLTS rounded to 0.1 uV; the full file (vin, fb, vd, u, y in volts) is in the researcher's folder.

meta.fields: vin = saw/101 at Q12 left base (DC removed); fb = feedback at Q12 right base; vd = vin - fb (Q12 differential input); u = 2VT*tanh(vd/2VT) (ladder drive); y = output at Q19 (before C14)
meta.model: q12_compress.py, LF False, implicit loop, Newton
